title: RC-02 Report/Appeal Production Green Gate

requiredEvidence.requirement: Canonical OpenAPI exposes report and appeal operations with exact paths, auth, schemas and errors.
Actor identity and target scope are derived and checked server-side.
Appeal eligibility and moderation state transitions are enforced server-side.
Duplicate reports/active appeals converge safely under retries and concurrency.
Immutable audit evidence is emitted for report and appeal mutations.
Security and integration tests prove privacy isolation, idempotency and authorization boundaries.

greenRule: RC-02 is GREEN only when every requiredEvidence item is PASS and CI records immutable evidence references.
implementationBlocker: The current GitHub main branch still lacks the synchronized application implementation baseline required for executable domain tests.
